from.place: Gluing module-sheaf maps over an étale covering family

title: Gluing module-sheaf maps over an étale covering family
statement: Let B be a commutative ring, a_i:U_i→X a jointly surjective family of étale morphisms of schemes and P,Q sheaves of B-modules on X_et. Let psi_i be maps between their localization restrictions. Assume their components on every étale object W with maps q_i:W→U_i and q_j:W→U_j agree, using the canonical liftEtaleIso identifications. Then there is a unique map P→Q whose localization restriction along every a_i is psi_i. The empty covering family on the empty scheme is allowed.

source.place: The concentration, overlap, and degree-zero gluing argument

proof.text: Use presheafHom(P,Q) as a sheaf on the small étale site. The arrows a_i cover its terminal object by joint surjectivity. The given descentComponent maps are matching sections by their existing naturality theorem.

Glue the matching sections with isSheafFor_arrows and evaluate the glued section at each object mapping to the terminal object. This constructs a natural transformation of B-module sheaves. The liftEtaleIso identities show its restrictions equal psi_i.
Transport restriction equality to inverse image via upperStarIsoLocalizationRestriction. The jointly surjective inverse-image family is jointly faithful, giving uniqueness.

lean.statement:
theorem existsUnique_etaleSheafHom_of_family
    (B : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing B]
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {I : Type u} {U : I → Scheme.{u}}
    (a : ∀ i, U i ⟶ X) [∀ i, Etale (a i)]
    (ha : ∀ x : X, ∃ (i : I) (y : U i), (a i).base y = x)
    (P Q : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B))
    (ψ : ∀ i, (localizationRestriction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B) (a i) inferInstance).obj P ⟶
      (localizationRestriction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B) (a i) inferInstance).obj Q)
    (hψ : ∀ (W : X.Etale) (i j : I)
      (q₁ : W ⟶ Scheme.Etale.mk (a i)) (q₂ : W ⟶ Scheme.Etale.mk (a j)),
      descentComponent (a i) (ψ i) q₁ = descentComponent (a j) (ψ j) q₂) :
    ∃! φ : P ⟶ Q,
      ∀ i, (localizationRestriction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B) (a i) inferInstance).map φ = ψ i
